title: Members of "{name}"
managedBy: Members, roles, teams and invitations are managed by WireCloud ({url}), not by this program. Here you see who is a member.
wirecloudTeams: Teams are created in WireCloud. They arrive here on their own, together with who is in them, once one of their members has used WireTerm. A project can then be shared with a team under its "Shares".
personal: This is the personal workspace. Inviting is allowed — that is exactly how it becomes a team. Whoever wants to keep private and company apart creates a regular organization next to it.
noKeyHint: Whoever has not set up a master password yet gets no project keys — they see the connections, but not their credentials. As soon as they do, the next sync delivers them.
memberProjectsHint: Whoever creates a project may then read, edit, share and delete it, like an administrator. Owners and administrators see every project anyway. Projects created earlier stay with whoever created them if this is switched off again.
teamsHint: The unit a project is shared with. Without teams the only share left is "the whole organization".
staleWarning: {name} no longer sees {projects} — but knows the keys and with them what was readable until just now. It only becomes tight with new keys: the credentials are re-encrypted, and only those who still have access get them.
